name: AGIEval
intro: AGIEval是一个以人为中心的基准测试，旨在评估基础模型在人类水平任务上的通用能力。它通过使用标准化考试（如高考、法学院入学考试和数学竞赛）来评估模型，以反映模型在现实世界场景中的表现。该基准测试揭示了模型的优势和局限性，为提升其通用能力提供了有价值的见解。
metric: 选择题准确率；填空题Exact Match与F1
intro_en: AGIEval is a human-centered benchmark designed to evaluate the general capabilities of foundation models on human-level tasks. It assesses models using standardized exams such as the Gaokao, law school entrance exams, and math competitions to reflect their performance in real-world scenarios. This benchmark reveals the strengths and limitations of models, providing valuable insights for improving their general abilities.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:2304.06364v2 Sections 3.1-3.3 and 4.2 plus repository commit 84ab72d94318290aad2e4ec820d535a95a1f7552. The diagram separates direct public Gaokao/SAT acquisition from reused LSAT, bilingual LogiQA, MATH, AQuA-RAT, and JEC-QA sources; shows source-specific selection and downsampling before objective-item filtering and normalization; and preserves the 20-task, 8,062-question release. Evaluation explicitly serializes all four 5-shot rules: AQuA/LogiQA/LSAT randomly sample five examples from training, choosing medium-length items; Gaokao/SAT each choose five medium-length examples from its original collected set and remove those five from the corresponding test set; JEC assigns the first 1,000 training items to test and selects five medium-sentence-length examples from the remainder; and MATH directly reuses Lewkowycz appendix exemplars without sampling. It also labels the MCQ versus fill-in branches and metrics.
